4	package api // import "miniflux.app/v2/internal/api"
5	
6	import (
7		json_parser "encoding/json"
8		"errors"
9		"net/http"
10	
11		"miniflux.app/v2/internal/http/request"
12		"miniflux.app/v2/internal/http/response"
13		"miniflux.app/v2/internal/model"
14		"miniflux.app/v2/internal/storage"
15		"miniflux.app/v2/internal/validator"
16	)
17	
18	// @effects: reads api_keys, writes api_keys
19	func (h *handler) createAPIKeyHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
20		userID := request.UserID(r)
21	
22		var apiKeyCreationRequest model.APIKeyCreationRequest
23		if err := json_parser.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&apiKeyCreationRequest); err != nil {
24			response.JSONBadRequest(w, r, err)
25			return
26		}
27	
28		if validationErr := validator.ValidateAPIKeyCreation(h.store, userID, &apiKeyCreationRequest); validationErr != nil {
29			response.JSONBadRequest(w, r, validationErr.Error())
30			return
31		}
32	
33		apiKey, err := h.store.CreateAPIKey(userID, apiKeyCreationRequest.Description)
34		if err != nil {
35			response.JSONServerError(w, r, err)
36			return
37		}
38	
39		response.JSONCreated(w, r, apiKey)
40	}
41	
42	// @effects: reads api_keys
43	func (h *handler) getAPIKeysHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
44		userID := request.UserID(r)
45		apiKeys, err := h.store.APIKeys(userID)
46		if err != nil {
47			response.JSONServerError(w, r, err)
48			return
49		}
50		response.JSON(w, r, apiKeys)
51	}
52	
53	// @effects: writes api_keys
54	func (h *handler) deleteAPIKeyHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
55		userID := request.UserID(r)
56		apiKeyID := request.RouteInt64Param(r, "apiKeyID")
57		if apiKeyID == 0 {
58			response.JSONBadRequest(w, r, errors.New("invalid API key ID"))
59			return
60		}
61	
62		if err := h.store.DeleteAPIKey(userID, apiKeyID); err != nil {
63			if errors.Is(err, storage.ErrAPIKeyNotFound) {
64				response.JSONNotFound(w, r)
65				return
66			}
67			response.JSONServerError(w, r, err)
68			return
69		}
70		response.NoContent(w, r)
71	}
72

122		}

125	}

18		store *storage.Storage

20	
21	// @effects: pure
22	func newMiddleware(s *storage.Storage) *middleware {

25	
26	// @effects: pure
27	func (m *middleware) withCORSHeaders(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
28		return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
29			w.Header().Set("Access-Control-Allow-Origin", "*")
30			w.Header().Set("Access-Control-Allow-Methods", "GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, OPTIONS")
31			w.Header().Set("Access-Control-Allow-Headers", "X-Auth-Token, Authorization, Content-Type, Accept")
32			if r.Method == http.MethodOptions {
33				w.Header().Set("Access-Control-Max-Age", "3600")
34				response.NoContent(w, r)
35				return
36			}
37			next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
38		})
39	}
40	
41	// @effects: pure
42	func (m *middleware) validateAPIKeyAuth(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
43		return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
44			clientIP := request.ClientIP(r)
45			token := r.Header.Get("X-Auth-Token")
46	
47			if token == "" {
48				slog.Debug("[API] Skipped API token authentication because no API Key has been provided",
49					slog.String("client_ip", clientIP),
50					slog.String("user_agent", r.UserAgent()),
51					slog.String("request_uri", r.RequestURI),
52				)
53				next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
54				return
55			}
56	
57			user, err := m.store.UserByAPIKey(token)
58			if err != nil {
59				response.JSONServerError(w, r, err)
60				return
61			}
62	
63			if user == nil {
64				slog.Warn("[API] No user found with the provided API key",
65					slog.Bool("authentication_failed", true),
66					slog.String("client_ip", clientIP),
67					slog.String("user_agent", r.UserAgent()),
68					slog.String("request_uri", r.RequestURI),
69				)
70				response.JSONUnauthorized(w, r)
71				return
72			}
73	
74			slog.Info("[API] User authenticated successfully with the API Token Authentication",
75				slog.Bool("authentication_successful", true),
76				slog.String("client_ip", clientIP),
77				slog.String("user_agent", r.UserAgent()),
78				slog.String("username", user.Username),
79				slog.String("request_uri", r.RequestURI),
80			)
81	
82			m.store.SetLastLogin(user.ID)
83			m.store.SetAPIKeyUsedTimestamp(user.ID, token)
84	
85			ctx := r.Context()
86			ctx = context.WithValue(ctx, request.UserIDContextKey, user.ID)
87			ctx = context.WithValue(ctx, request.UserTimezoneContextKey, user.Timezone)
88			ctx = context.WithValue(ctx, request.IsAdminUserContextKey, user.IsAdmin)
89			ctx = context.WithValue(ctx, request.IsAuthenticatedContextKey, true)
90	
91			next.ServeHTTP(w, r.WithContext(ctx))
92		})
93	}
94	
95	// @effects: pure
96	func (m *middleware) validateBasicAuth(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
97		return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
98			if request.IsAuthenticated(r) {
99				next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
100				return
101			}
102	
103			w.Header().Set("WWW-Authenticate", `Basic realm="Restricted"`)
104	
105			clientIP := request.ClientIP(r)
106			username, password, authOK := r.BasicAuth()
107			if !authOK {
108				slog.Warn("[API] No Basic HTTP Authentication header sent with the request",
109					slog.Bool("authentication_failed", true),
110					slog.String("client_ip", clientIP),
111					slog.String("user_agent", r.UserAgent()),
112					slog.String("request_uri", r.RequestURI),
113				)
114				response.JSONUnauthorized(w, r)
115				return
116			}
117	
118			if config.Opts.DisableLocalAuth() {
119				slog.Warn("[API] Blocking Basic HTTP Authentication attempt, local auth is disabled",
120					slog.Bool("authentication_failed", true),
121					slog.String("client_ip", clientIP),
122					slog.String("user_agent", r.UserAgent()),
123					slog.String("request_uri", r.RequestURI),
124				)
125				response.JSONUnauthorized(w, r)
126				return
127			}
128	
129			if username == "" || password == "" {
130				slog.Warn("[API] Empty username or password provided during Basic HTTP Authentication",
131					slog.Bool("authentication_failed", true),
132					slog.String("client_ip", clientIP),
133					slog.String("user_agent", r.UserAgent()),
134					slog.String("request_uri", r.RequestURI),
135				)
136				response.JSONUnauthorized(w, r)
137				return
138			}
139	
140			if err := m.store.CheckPassword(username, password); err != nil {
141				slog.Warn("[API] Invalid username or password provided during Basic HTTP Authentication",
142					slog.Bool("authentication_failed", true),
143					slog.String("client_ip", clientIP),
144					slog.String("user_agent", r.UserAgent()),
145					slog.String("username", username),
146					slog.String("request_uri", r.RequestURI),
147				)
148				response.JSONUnauthorized(w, r)
149				return
150			}
151	
152			user, err := m.store.UserByUsername(username)
153			if err != nil {
154				response.JSONServerError(w, r, err)
155				return
156			}
157	
158			if user == nil {
159				slog.Warn("[API] User not found while using Basic HTTP Authentication",
160					slog.Bool("authentication_failed", true),
161					slog.String("client_ip", clientIP),
162					slog.String("user_agent", r.UserAgent()),
163					slog.String("username", username),
164					slog.String("request_uri", r.RequestURI),
165				)
166				response.JSONUnauthorized(w, r)
167				return
168			}
169	
170			slog.Info("[API] User authenticated successfully with the Basic HTTP Authentication",
171				slog.Bool("authentication_successful", true),
172				slog.String("client_ip", clientIP),
173				slog.String("user_agent", r.UserAgent()),
174				slog.String("username", username),
175				slog.String("request_uri", r.RequestURI),
176			)
177	
178			m.store.SetLastLogin(user.ID)
179	
180			ctx := r.Context()
181			ctx = context.WithValue(ctx, request.UserIDContextKey, user.ID)
182			ctx = context.WithValue(ctx, request.UserTimezoneContextKey, user.Timezone)
183			ctx = context.WithValue(ctx, request.IsAdminUserContextKey, user.IsAdmin)
184			ctx = context.WithValue(ctx, request.IsAuthenticatedContextKey, true)
185	
186			next.ServeHTTP(w, r.WithContext(ctx))
187		})
188	}
